thread:
nina: drop: Baxter staged a heist on the laundry basket and now refuses to explain his motives. photo: https://files.redwood.example/baxter-laundry-heist.jpg 43645c
omar: the audacity. that stare says "i was born for folded socks" :joy: (reacted with :heart:)
riley: mission briefing: identify which sock was compromised and offer immediate treats as restitution.
jade: Baxter looks like he read one book on dramatic exits and now he's committed to the bit. iconic.
nina: update: Baxter dragged an entire sock pile into a fort and is currently issuing nap-related mandates.
omar: gif incoming...
giphy-bot: (posted sock-fort victory gif) https://giphy.example/sock-fort.gif
riley: local ordinance proposal: if a cat builds a fort, all meetings under 15 minutes should be declared "fort-respectful" and postponed.
jade: also investigating Baxter's preferred pillow placement strategy. it is suspiciously ergonomic.
nina: scientific note: Baxter will only accept rubs if offered with theatrical sighs. negotiation tactic.
omar: i volunteer as tribute for theatrical sighs.
riley: poll: heart = on-site Baxter cameo, clap = remote Baxter cameo via video, laugh = just send more sock-fort photos (emoji poll)
jade: i'm team photos + tiny hat. optional tiny hat.
nina: hat update: Baxter tolerated one small beret for 3.2 seconds and then demanded snacks. proof of concept.
omar: action item: riley to assemble tiny hat and ceremonial treat sash. honorary title: "Laundry Ambassador".
riley: sash design draft: tasteful stripes, one pocket for treats. will circulate mockup.
jade: closing: Baxter has requested that all future laundry be subjected to a sniff test. objections?
nina: none. ratified by five silent emojis and one loud purr. :zzz:
